independence: Model written by a Claude agent from the public design prose (TLA+, a different formalism and author from verification/bounded/authority_models.py); checked by TLC 1.7.4 (independent_tool). The design package was authored by a ChatGPT design agent and Claude agents; ADR-0117 (proposed) decides whether an AI reviewer counts as independent. No independent_reviewer sign-off exists.

criteria.criterion: formal model of Room/Space grants, restrictions, ceilings, governance quorum, bilateral links and revocation races with no self-escalation or transitive-authority counterexample
criteria.note: TLC finds no counterexample in the three bounded scenarios (independent_tool met for this bound); six fault-injected mutations are each caught. Partial because (1) the gate also requires independent_reviewer sign-off, (2) bounds are small (3 principals, 2 Spaces, 5-6 environment steps), and (3) the model adopts two semantics the docs leave open (cascade revocation, sub-delegated Space authority rejected) - see README 'Design gaps'.
Vectors exist; no implementation exists (engineering not authorized).
